workerToken.title: Worker token
workerToken.description: Bearer token used by workers and orchestrator to call Source Scan Hub.

workerActorId.title: Worker Actor ID
workerActorId.description: Existing Source Scan Hub worker Actor ID.

mode.title: Autopilot mode
mode.description: auto keeps building the master source baseline until convergence, then switches to daily updates.

maxResolverWorkers.title: Maximum resolver workers
maxResolverWorkers.description: Adaptive upper bound; starts at 4 and only scales when 403/429/error rates are healthy.

maxCycleSpendUsd.title: Maximum spend per cycle (USD)
maxCycleSpendUsd.description: Hard local ceiling for new Apify child-run compute in one Autopilot cycle.

maxCycleMinutes.title: Maximum cycle minutes
maxCycleMinutes.description: Stops launching new child runs after this duration; remaining queue waits for the next scheduled cycle.
